question: Work out the ratio of absolute change of unfavorable sentiment to that of favorable one from 2006 to 2016?

steps.description: Locate the data point for unfavorable sentiment in 2006 and read its value
Locate the data point for unfavorable sentiment in 2016 and read its value
Subtract the 2006 value from the 2016 value to get the absolute change
Locate the data point for favorable sentiment in 2006 and read its value
Locate the data point for favorable sentiment in 2016 and read its value
Subtract the 2006 value from the 2016 value to get the absolute change
Take the absolute value of the favorable sentiment change from step_6
Divide the unfavorable sentiment change from step_3 by the favorable sentiment change from step_7
